answer: A concrete sybil defense is sedimented reputation: an identity equals its cumulative public work, so a fake account must rebuild that history from nothing, paying real compute each step. Karst forms only through slow erosion, no shortcut fakes the cave; a reef accrues one coral generation at a time, no shortcut fakes the mass. Each identity carries a unique cipher binding its history, so duplicates are rejected on-ledger. Splitting one stake into many identities yields many empty histories, each priced in the same labor.
